---
title: "Add Askr"
---

`0.13.1` is the current release. The public format is `askr-html`. Quiet Quartz
is the visual theme.

```bash
quarto add arfiligol/askr@v0.13.1 --no-prompt
```

```yaml
project:
  type: website

website:
  title: Project Name
  site-url: https://example.github.io/project/

format:
  askr-html:
    toc: true
    toc-title: Sections
    toc-location: right
    respect-user-color-scheme: true
    smooth-scroll: false
```

The installed copy lives at `_extensions/arfiligol/askr`. Askr does not fetch
fonts, icons, or styles from a CDN.

To move to a newer tag, install that tag and render the project again. Commit
the updated `_extensions` copy. Reinstall a reviewed tag instead of editing
files inside `_extensions/arfiligol/askr`.

## Quarto compatibility

Askr 0.13.1 retains support for stable Quarto releases in `>=1.9.38 <1.11`.
Quarto 1.10.18 remains the reproducible gallery and CI baseline; consumers
may use a stable release inside the supported range instead of that exact patch.
Older tags retain their original requirements.

Set `respect-user-color-scheme: true` to follow the reader's system preference.
Set `smooth-scroll: false` for consumers using the RequireJS compatibility setup.
These remain consumer-selected options; Askr's format defaults are unchanged.

The optional Logout and image viewer retain their existing configuration.
See [Protected docs and logout](protected-docs.qmd) and
[Image viewer](image-viewer.qmd) for configuration and ownership boundaries.

## Optional language selector

Askr 0.10.0 adds an optional Header language selector. It is absent unless
`askr.languages` is configured; all other defaults remain unchanged. Each
language project sets its own `current` code. Askr follows configured links and
does not infer a language from the URL or translate pages.

```yaml
askr:
  languages:
    current: en
    items:
      - code: en
        label: English
        href: https://example.github.io/project/en/
      - code: zh-TW
        label: 繁體中文
        href: https://example.github.io/project/
```

Each entry needs a unique nonempty code, nonempty label and HTTPS URL or
domain-root path. See [Language selector](languages.qmd) for validation,
accessibility and menu behavior.

## Dense scientific pages

Use site-level `askr.reading-width: wide` for a 780px body base; `normal` keeps
630px. Both follow Askr's responsive scaling and preserve native width escapes.

```yaml
askr:
  reading-width: wide
  page-facts:
    - {key: node-role, label: Role}
    - {key: reader-task, label: Reader task}
```

Pages keep flat front matter such as `node-role: Concept` and
`reader-task: "Distinguish the modes and their response."`. Askr places set
values below the description and preserves native author/date metadata.
Unset values produce no facts row. See [Tables](../components/tables.qmd),
[Mathematics](../components/mathematics.qmd) and [Figures](figures.qmd) for
table classes, three-level Copy settings and the wide-figure utility.

Actual non-executing renders and browser observations cover stable 1.9.38
and 1.10.18, plus 1.10.16 as a diagnostic prerelease across upstream Sass
changes. This is not an observation of every intervening patch or a promise
that prereleases are supported. The native grouped-tab runtime, Bootstrap tab
implementation and tabset markup used by Askr were unchanged at the inspected
boundaries. Exact inputs, findings and limits are recorded in
[the validation receipt](../VALIDATION.md).

Before extending the range, inspect upstream changes to native tabs, theme
switching, navigation/search and grid markup, then render and operate the
affected Askr components using the proposed version. Quarto 1.11 is excluded
from this candidate because it changes navigation and theme-control markup;
support requires its own investigation, not a multi-version adapter framework.
